[[File:Glyph_of_strength.png|thumb|The glyph.]]
The '''Glyph of Strength''' was an ancient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] symbol. According to legend, it had [[Magic/Legends|magical]] properties to it, which made Ewoks nearby more resistant and hardy.

The glyph depicted a mountain with two moons above it. [[Ewok glyphs]] would often be carved on trees where Ewoks lived.
